title: acme-app
prompt: Plan ACME-212: add a Pro plan with our payment provider, and retire the old renewal job.

people.role: Engineer, runs Claude Code and Codex

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.desc: Anyone with an account. 4,120 active, 312 on annual plans.

nodes.label: Web app
nodes.desc: The product people use in the browser.

nodes.label: Payment provider
nodes.desc: Third party. Charges cards, sends Payment confirmed.

nodes.label: Core API
nodes.desc: Accounts, plans, everything the web app asks for.

nodes.label: Renewal job
nodes.desc: Runs nightly, bills annual plans that are due, mails the receipt.

checks.name: Living Map: nothing agreed on these yet

answers.renewal: jobs/renewal.ts runs at 02:00 and bills every annual plan whose period ends that day, then mails the receipt through the email service. 312 customers are on it. If it goes, they stop renewing.
answers.db: users, plans and invoices in Postgres. There is no plan column on users yet; the plan lives on the plans table by period.
answers.email: Receipts, renewal notices and trial reminders. Codex's ACME-219 wants the trial reminders off.
answers.*: I drew what I know on the map. Click a box for its sources, or ask me about one.
